findings.body: The HTTP hook uses request mode, where `requestPluginToolApproval` returns `deniedReason: "plugin-approval"` after explicit denial, approval timeout, or an unavailable approval route. Setting `approvalRequired` for all these outcomes makes `toMcpToolResult` report `openclaw/resultStatus: "waiting"` even though the approval has terminated. Carry the resolved approval outcome through this boundary and reserve waiting for pending approval.
findings.title: Preserve terminal approval outcomes

findings.body: `usedIds` retains the complete caller-controlled ID without a length limit. The 1 MiB request-body limit permits nearly 1 MiB string IDs, including calls to unavailable tools because registration precedes tool lookup. An authenticated local client, including a non-owner client, can therefore retain gigabytes through sequential requests before reaching the 4096-call limit, exhausting gateway memory. Limit retained ID bytes or store bounded-size digests for replay detection.
findings.title: Bound the size of retained request IDs

overall_explanation: The current diff still misclassifies terminal approval failures and permits excessive request-ID retention. Source and installed SDK contracts were inspected; no tests were run. Retained evidence records a 37/38 precheck and a passing five-test version matrix. Full-candidate validation and evidence sealing remain unverified.
